result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood pressure was 168/98 at the surgery on 25 September 2026.
The surgery would like to check it again before making any decisions.

## What you need to do
1. Use the machine in the surgery waiting room. Measure your blood pressure once a week for 4 weeks.
2. Give your readings to reception.

## Dates and medicines
- 25 September 2026: your blood pressure at the surgery was 168/98.
- Thursday 29 October 2026 at 09:30: your next appointment with the practice nurse.
- Medicines: the letter lists none.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does the reading 168/98 mean?
- What will happen after the 4 weeks of readings?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
